name: MPDL Ltd
about: Incorporated in 2002, MPDL Ltd is in the construction business and other Real estate activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Projects Undertaken:[1][2]
The company is developing a multistoried commercial tower, MI Tower, in Faridabad (Haryana), which is nearing completion with finishing work in progress. It has also received booking advances/instalments from customers against the project. In FY23, the company secured approval from the Director, Town and Country Planning to increase the project’s saleable area from 124,476 sq ft. to 208,609 sq.ft.

pros: Stock is trading at 0.33 times its book value
cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of 0.49% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -4.44% over last 3 years.
Company might be capitalizing the interest cost
Company has high debtors of 622 days.
Working capital days have increased from 1,492 days to 2,249 days
